load_xnli_metric: load the XNLI cross-lingual natural language inference metric using evaluate.load
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the XNLI metric
run_xnli_evaluation: run the XNLI metric to evaluate cross-lingual natural language inference predictions
combine_xnli_with_other_metrics: combine the XNLI metric with other evaluation metrics using evaluate.combine
list_available_evaluation_modules: list available evaluation modules using evaluate.list_evaluation_modules
